fixture_name: Six HAWK pedestrian crossings — US final design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Driver comprehension of novel HAWK displays is a documented safety issue, and education measures are a legitimate Final Design RSA consideration across six closely spaced crossings.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-US-001 quote supplies context on HAWK novelty but does not directly support the pivotal low-familiarity/comprehension claim, which rests on an uncited assumption, capping at 1.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed strictly as a safety_concern with no compliance claims made, keeping safety and categorical framework semantics distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Placement and site selection are specified, but 'EDUCATIONAL-type' plaque lacks defined wording or MUTCD basis, and scope silently narrows from six sites to two without rationale, limiting viability.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly identified as affected road users and the hazard scenario centers on their exposure during the active pedestrian phase.

justifications.substance: Pedestrian clearance adequacy for slow-moving child pedestrians at school-fronting crossings is a genuine, scheme-specific safety issue well suited to a final-design-stage audit.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-US-016 quote is verbatim but addresses elderly pedestrians, only analogously supporting the child-specific pivotal claim, so it cannot earn full credit despite no invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed purely as a safety-concern verification ('verify'/'consider') without asserting a compliance violation, and the 3.5 ft/s figure is consistent with US/MUTCD clearance-timing semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific (3.5 ft/s, both named sites), actionable (reprogramming plus term-time coordination), and viable under standard signal-timing practice; not a null recommendation.
justifications.vru_coverage: Child pedestrian exposure is the explicit focus of the finding, with arrival/discharge surge dynamics directly considered.
